adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is assigned `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null`. Immediately after, for collective team events it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If both `eventType.destinationCalendar` and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` are falsy, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the optional-chained `push` no-ops and the previously collected `teamDestinationCalendars` (built from `users.slice(1)` members) is never applied to `evt` at all.
